name: Victorian, double-base
note: Before 1906: heavy guns slow to load (12"/35 70-100 s), hand-worked mounts, 13° elevation, the brown-powder short guns. Double-base: cordite MD and SC, the German RPC/12, Japan's and Italy's.

name: Victorian, double-base, brass-cased
note: Before 1906: heavy guns slow to load (12"/35 70-100 s), hand-worked mounts, 13° elevation, the brown-powder short guns. The main charge in a brass cartridge case, the fore charge in silk in a tin (Germany: RP C/12; Seydlitz's 62 charges burned at Dogger Bank and her magazines held).

name: Victorian, single-base
note: Before 1906: heavy guns slow to load (12"/35 70-100 s), hand-worked mounts, 13° elevation, the brown-powder short guns. Single-base nitrocellulose: the USN's SPD, the French poudre B, the Russian pyroxylin.

name: Great War, double-base
note: 1906-1921: RN 13.5" and 15" 20°, German 13.5-16°; the 12" 3.3-3.5%, the 15" 1.7 ("the most accurate battleship gun"). Double-base: cordite MD and SC, the German RPC/12, Japan's and Italy's.

name: Great War, double-base, brass-cased
note: 1906-1921: RN 13.5" and 15" 20°, German 13.5-16°; the 12" 3.3-3.5%, the 15" 1.7 ("the most accurate battleship gun"). The main charge in a brass cartridge case, the fore charge in silk in a tin (Germany: RP C/12; Seydlitz's 62 charges burned at Dogger Bank and her magazines held).

name: Great War, single-base
note: 1906-1921: RN 13.5" and 15" 20°, German 13.5-16°; the 12" 3.3-3.5%, the 15" 1.7 ("the most accurate battleship gun"). Single-base nitrocellulose: the USN's SPD, the French poudre B, the Russian pyroxylin.

name: Treaty, double-base
note: 1922-1936: delay coils and stiffer mounts (16" 1.9%, 8" 2.0); dual-purpose mounts at 45°. Double-base: cordite MD and SC, the German RPC/12, Japan's and Italy's.

note: 1922-1936: delay coils and stiffer mounts (16" 1.9%, 8" 2.0); dual-purpose mounts at 45°. Single-base nitrocellulose: the USN's SPD, the French poudre B, the Russian pyroxylin.

name: Treaty, diglycol
note: 1922-1936: delay coils and stiffer mounts (16" 1.9%, 8" 2.0); dual-purpose mounts at 45°. Diglycol, cool double-base: the German RPC/38.

name: Second War, double-base
note: 1937-1949: USN 16" training 4 °/s, 38 cm 5; the 5"/38 25 and 1.7%. Double-base: cordite MD and SC, the German RPC/12, Japan's and Italy's.
